name: Nha Trang Beach
kicker: The city sand along Trần Phú
summary: City sand on Trần Phú: swim and walk the seven-kilometre shore for a beach day on the bay. Hotels face that sand. January to August are the dry months both Vietnam Tourism and the tourism bureau name, with rain from September to December. After dark the same shore is the walk, and the night market is the 137 m street behind 46 Trần Phú.
getThere: You are on Trần Phú. From the airport, minutes were not printed.
heroCaption: The city sand, the wash, and the towers along Trần Phú
body: This is the beach the city is for. Vietnam Tourism treats Nha Trang Beach as the day on the sand and calls Trần Phú a seven-kilometre beach. Hotels face that shore. Swim by day and walk the same sand after dark.
Vietnam Tourism and the tourism bureau both call January to August the dry season and September to December the rainy season. The tourism bureau gives an average of 26°C.
The night market is the 137 m walking street behind the cultural centre at 46 Trần Phú, in Lộc Thọ. Entry is free.

figures.caption: Swimmers in the wash, from the same photograph as the long shore
figures.alt: People standing in the shallow water on Nha Trang’s city beach

gettingThere: The sand is Trần Phú. From a hotel on that road you walk out. From Cam Ranh, the AIP says 27 km from the centre, the city lying to the north, and Vietnam Tourism says about 30 km south. Shuttles, taxis, and ride-hailing are the modes Vietnam Tourism names.

legs.heading: From Trần Phú
legs.body: You are already on the beach road. The night market is behind 46 Trần Phú.

legs.heading: From the airport
legs.body: 27 km on the AIP, about 30 km on Vietnam Tourism.

legs.heading: From the station
legs.body: The station is in the centre. Walk or ride out to Trần Phú from there.

admissionNote: Check on arrival. Island boats and the cable are separate.
